fields.acceptance: run-abandon.txtar: after rhiza run abandon the worktree folder is gone, git branch --list cs/<slug> is empty and the output reports remove-worktree done; with an uncommitted file in the worktree both are kept and the output says the worktree is dirty
fields.statement: rhiza run abandon removes the run's clean worktree and deletes its local branch, reporting each as done, already gone, or kept because the worktree is dirty; the remote branch and PR are untouched
